compact/powershell/windsurf/ollama-embed.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. if (-not (Test-Path .gitignore)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path .gitignore | Out-Null } Add-Content -Path .gitignore -Value '.chunkhound.json' # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and Claude Code CLI for research. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ @' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "claude-code-cli" } } '@ | Set-Content -Path '.chunkhound.json' -Encoding utf8 # Configure Windsurf to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. if (Test-Path "$HOME/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json") { Write-Host @' $HOME/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "mcpServers": { "ChunkHound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } '@ } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$HOME/.codeium/windsurf" | Out-Null @' { "mcpServers": { "ChunkHound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } '@ | Set-Content -Path "$HOME/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json" -Encoding utf8 } # Build ChunkHound's search index for this project. chunkhound index .
